Twenty-two years ago today, the world got a girl who cries at sad reels and happy endings alike, who laughs with her whole face, and who loves so completely that it overflows. Lucky world. Luckier me.

Happy birthday, meri butterfly. 🦋

For your twenty-second year

I hope this year is gentle with you. I hope your tears are only the happy kind, and that when the other kind comes, you remember there's a boy 49 kilometres away who would cross anything to wipe them.

I hope your chai is always the right temperature, your hair behaves on the days that matter, and every dua you whisper comes back answered. 🤲

And more than anything, I hope this is the last birthday we spend on two sides of a line on a map.

From a game to forever

the short, true story of us

🎮 3rd April, 2025

A game, a stranger, a hello

We met on Plato, of all places. Neither of us knew that one random chat would turn into the most important conversation of my life. Somewhere, the universe was grinning.

🌅 The nights after

The nights that forgot to end

We talked until the sky turned pink, and then did it again the next night, and the next. I have never been happier to lose sleep. The sunrise became our goodnight.

💞 Somewhere in between

When friends became us

Between the silly jokes and the 4am confessions, I realised I wasn't waiting for your messages anymore. I was waiting for you. The friendship grew into something I didn't have a name for, until suddenly I did.

🤍 Today

49 kilometres and one border

Jammu to Sialkot is a short drive for anyone else. For us it's a border, paperwork and a whole lot of patience. But love has always been better at geography than governments.

a line on a map, never a line between us

A letter I owe you

read it slowly, please

Meri pyari bachi,

There's something I need to say properly. Not in a rushed text, not in the middle of an argument, but here, on your day, where it can stay.

I'm sorry.

I'm sorry for every time I made you cry. For the words I said when I was angry or tired or scared, words you never deserved. For the times I didn't listen when you needed me to. For every moment I made you feel like anything less than the most precious person in my world, because that is exactly what you are.

You feel everything so deeply, and your heart is the softest thing I've ever been trusted with. Seeing you cry breaks something in me, and knowing that sometimes I was the reason is the heaviest thing I carry.

I won't promise you I'll never get it wrong again, because you deserve honesty more than pretty lies. But I promise to try harder. To be gentler. To pause before I speak. To hold your heart the way it deserves to be held.

Thank you for forgiving me more times than I've earned. Thank you for staying. I love you, Zaina, even in the moments I'm terrible at showing it. 🤍

💋 All 22 delivered. The rest I'm saving to give you in person, inshallah. Consider this an advance. Ummmmaah! 😘

Someday, inshallah

Every day that passes is one day closer. I'm working, planning and praying, and I'm not stopping until that border is just a story we tell.

I picture it all the time: morning chai together, arguing over what to watch, your cold feet on my legs, your head on my shoulder with nothing and no one in between us.

I'm asking every good star in the sky to fall on our side. And when they do, I'm going to marry you, mera jigar. That isn't a wish. It's a plan. 💍

My duas for you

the ones I whisper after every namaz, written here so you can hold them

🤲

For your new year

بَارَكَ ٱللّٰهُ فِي عُمُرِكِ

Barakallahu fi umrik: may Allah bless your life

Ya Allah, bless every year of her life, and every single day inside those years. Let twenty-two be the most beautiful one yet.

🌿

Lambi umar

Ya Allah, give my Zaina a long, long life, full of health, laughter and ease. Keep every illness far from her, every nazar away from her, and let every sadness pass quickly.

🦋

For her soft heart

Ya Allah, she feels everything so deeply. Let her tears be few, and only ever the happy kind. Put sukoon in her heart, and keep her smile exactly the way it is in these photos.

🏡

For her family

Ya Allah, keep her parents and everyone she loves healthy and happy, and let them always be as proud of her as I am.

💍

For us

رَبِّ يَسِّرْ وَلَا تُعَسِّرْ

Rabbi yassir wa la tu'assir: my Lord, make it easy, not hard

Ya Allah, You know the distance between Jammu and Sialkot, and You know what is in our hearts. Open the doors that are closed, soften the hearts that need softening, and make our path easy. Bring the day of our nikah soon, very soon.

🤍

For our forever

رَبَّنَا هَبْ لَنَا مِنْ أَزْوَاجِنَا وَذُرِّيَّاتِنَا قُرَّةَ أَعْيُنٍ

Our Lord, grant us from our spouses and children the coolness of our eyes (Al-Furqan 25:74)

Let us become each other's sukoon: halal, together, under one roof, with nothing and no one in between.
